name: act
description: Agent task tracker. A single-binary task tracker designed for AI coding agents as the primary user. State lives as append-only JSON op files inside a nested git repo at .act/ — its own .git/ directory, gitignored from the surrounding code repo. Concurrent agents merge their writes with plain git semantics. No server, no database, no schema setup.

interface.shortDescription: Agent task tracker with project-local git-backed state.
interface.longDescription: Track, claim, close, and coordinate agent work through the act skill and MCP tools, with state stored in each project's nested .act/ git repo.
